user.title: Select a detected Govee device
user.description: Devices found by Home Assistant Bluetooth (including ESPHome proxies). Select the H70B3 to fill in its Bluetooth address automatically.

h6069.title: Add H6069 via local LAN
h6069.description: Full panel control is physically verified through UDP LAN. Enable LAN Control in Govee Home. Setup sends no pattern.

h70b3.title: Add H70B3 via Bluetooth
h70b3.description: Full 520-LED control requires a local Bluetooth adapter or an active ESPHome Bluetooth proxy. Setup sends no image.

confirm.title: Add {name}
confirm.description: Use discovered H70B3 at {address} through Bluetooth or an active proxy? No image is sent during setup.

not_found.title: No H70B3 detected
not_found.description: Home Assistant has not detected a connectable H70B3 through its Bluetooth adapters or ESPHome proxies. You can refresh discovery, enter a known MAC address manually, or configure H6069 over LAN.

error.invalid_address: Enter a valid Bluetooth MAC address.
error.invalid_topology: This is not a valid H6069 Shape Recognition topology.
error.topology_count_mismatch: The imported topology has a different panel count.

abort.already_configured: This Govee device is already configured.

error.invalid_topology: This is not a valid H6069 Shape Recognition topology.
error.topology_count_mismatch: The imported topology has a different panel count.

init.title: Model options
init.description: Changes reload only this device. Reloading never transmits a physical frame. For H6069, an optional captured Shape Recognition Base64 value is strictly validated before use.
